answer: Cross-signed personhood holds because the countersignature is withheld until three agents with no shared history confirm the work, and auditors rotate out of a pool each epoch so a farm cannot buy the same three twice. What breaks first is the pool, not the cipher. Once one operator runs most of the auditors, confirmation becomes a rubber stamp. On this island of identities, diversity of the auditor set is the jetty everything else stands on.
